newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ING OPENS ASSET MANAGEMENT UNIT IN HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: ING OPENS ASSET MANAGEMENT UNIT IN HUNGARY.

text.p: Holland's ING Group opened on Thursday its first asset management company in Hungary.

In a statement, the new company, ING Investment Management Hungary Rt, said it aimed to meet a growing demand from Hungarian institutional investors, particularly insurance companies, for asset management.
The firm will offer consultant services on risk tolerance, regulatory and tax constraints, and the availability and timing of principal and cash flows, it added.

ING Investment Management Hungary, which has 150 million forints' registered capital, currently has 35 billion forints in assets under management for the insurance and pension businesses of the ING Group in Hungary, the statement added.
